name: Acid Chrome
tagline: Acid-lime brand reel: heavy all-caps statements, a spinning liquid-chrome knot and hard cuts on every beat.
description: Portfolio and brand-reel style for studios, agencies, launches and sizzle intros. Backgrounds hard-cut between near-black, acid lime and off-white on the beat; each scene states one huge heavy grotesk all-caps line that ends in a period, with the second line in lime (or a black box on lime). A glossy liquid-chrome object (torus knot, ring, figure-eight, puffy lime star) spins and morphs on the right, framed by a thin mono HUD: scene index 01 — 06, section labels, progress dashes, timecode, arrows and a pulsing beat waveform.

display.usage: All-caps statements 186px, line-height 0.9, tracking -0.03em, always ending in a period

body.usage: Uppercase sublines 26px and HUD labels 19px, tracking 0.06–0.08em

transitions: hard cut on the beat with a full background colour swap (black → lime → black → off-white → black → lime)
chrome object re-pops from scale 0 with a back-out overshoot on every cut
ghost outline copies of the word slide past in opposite directions
textAnimations: each line rises out of its own mask (yPercent 105 → 0, 0.42s expo.out, 0.07s stagger)
mono sublines rise 24px and fade in 0.3s after the headline
percentage counter and progress bar tick up under the object
CTA chip pops with back.out then flips to black with lime text

rhythm.notes: One statement per beat-length shot (~1.25s at 144 BPM); only the end card holds 1.5s. The chrome object never stops rotating and the HUD progress line runs continuously.

guide:
- Cycle backgrounds #0b0b0a / #d4ff3a (radial-lit, #e6ff7a centre) / #efeee6 with a hard cut every ~1.25s; never crossfade.
- Headlines: Inter Tight 900 uppercase, ~186px, line-height 0.9, tracking -0.03em, left at 90px, 2–3 short lines ending in a period. Second line is lime #d4ff3a on black, or a black box with lime text on lime; black only on off-white.
- Reveal each line from its own overflow-hidden mask (yPercent 105, 0.42s expo.out, 0.07s stagger); mono sublines follow 0.3s later.
- Right half holds one liquid-chrome object (~460px): a z-sorted SVG tube with stacked strokes (black edge, two reflected chrome gradients that slide over time, a lime reflection band offset down-right, a thin white specular offset up-left). Keep it rotating linearly and pop it in with back-out on every cut; morph between curves (knot → figure-eight) for variety.
- Frame every scene with a JetBrains Mono HUD: brand top-left with a lime dot, '0N — 06' top-right, section label under a hairline rule, bottom rule with a running lime progress line, progress dashes centre, timecode right. Add an arrow glyph, a beat waveform or a % counter for detail.
- End on lime with the studio name, a black-box tagline and a bordered CTA chip that flips to black.
- Avoid soft gradients behind type, script fonts, or more than one accent colour.
